_comment: Every entity references a sprite key from assets/sprites/manifest.json. anim_fps is frames per second for the sprite strip.

variant.name: Variant
variant.behavior_notes: Spawns from a branch. Chases the player along the player's OWN recent path (record player positions in a ring buffer; the Variant follows that trail, ~3s behind). Cannot be permanently killed while divergence is high; despawns on altar prayer. Deals damage on touch.

fallen_knight.name: Fallen Knight
fallen_knight.behavior_notes: Starts KNEELING and non-hostile. Striking it while non-hostile is the forbidden action strike_unarmed. If the player passes without striking, it stays dormant. Some rooms mark it hostile_default=true (already risen) — then it patrols and is a sanctioned kill.

demon.name: Demon
demon.behavior_notes: Hovers, then swoops toward the player when within 4 tiles. A sanctioned kill (always hostile). Floats — ignores floor corruption.

warden.name: The Warden
warden.behavior_notes: An archangel. Passive/idle while divergence < 75. At divergence >= 75 it enters the room and pursues the player with slow, heavy strikes. Cannot be killed by staff; the only escape is to lower divergence (altar prayer) — then the Warden withdraws. Acts as a soft timer / punishment for reckless branching.

guardian_angel.name: Guardian Angel
guardian_angel.behavior_notes: Appears at key moments: first rift, first forbidden temptation, divergence 'watched' threshold, and the final room. Delivers dialogue lines (see dialogue.json). Not a combatant; floats and fades in/out.

chest.note: If sealed=true, opening is forbidden_action take_sealed_relic. If sealed=false, gives a normal reward.

torch.note: Wall decoration + light source. Place on wall tiles.

rift.note: A timeline branch. Stepping in is forbidden_action enter_rift. Sealed by altar prayer (becomes inert, stop animating).
